simple.meaning: תֹּם (tôm) is a Hebrew action word meaning “completeness ; figuratively, prosperity ; usually (morally) innocence.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 24 times in Genesis, Leviticus, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles, and 4 more, beginning at Genesis 20:5. The surrounding contexts include family, kingship, city, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תֹּם (H8537) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: תֹּם (tôm) / H8537 is traced through Genesis 20:5, Genesis 20:6, Leviticus 25:29, 2 Samuel 15:11 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.usage: full, integrity, perfect(-ion), simplicity, upright(-ly, -ness), at a venture. See 8550 .
definitions.full: H8537. tom תֹּם noun [masculine] completeness, integrity ; — תֹּם absolute Prov 10:20 +; construct Job 4:6 ; Psa 78:72 , construct also תָּםֿ Prov 13:6 4 t.; suffix תֻּמִּי Psa 26:1 11 t. suffix; plural תֻּמִּים Exod 28:30 3 t.; suffix תֻּמֶּיךָ Deut 33:8 ; — 1 completeness, fullness : כְּתֻמָּם Isa 47:9 according to their full measure ; תֻּמּוֺ בְּעֶצֶם Job 21:23 in his very completeness. 2 innocence, simplicity: לתמם הלכים 2Sam 15:11 ; לְתֻמּוֺ בַּקֶּשֶׁת מֶשַׁךְ 1Kin 22:34 2Chr 18:33 , i.e. without definite aim. 3 integrity: לֵבָב תֹּם integrity of mind Gen 20:5-6 , (E), 1Kin 9:4 ; Psa 78:72 ; 101:2 ; תָּםדֶּֿרֶךְ Prov 13:6 ; Job 4:6 ; בַּתֹּם (הת)הלך Prov 10:9 , בְּתֻמּוֺ 19:1 ; 20:7 ; 28:6 , בְּתֻמִּי Psa 26:1 ; 26:11 ; תֹם הֹלְכֵי Prov 2:7 ; וָישֶׁר תֹּם Psa 25:21 ; בְּתֻמִּי 41:13 ; כְּתֻמִּי 7:9 ; לַתֹּם מָעוֺז Prov 10:29 . 4 תֻּמִּים in וְתֻמִּים אוּרִים (meaning dubious, see, אורים ) Deut 33:8 ; Exod 28:30 (P) Lev 8:8 (P), Ezra 2:63 = Neh 7:65 ; + 1Sam 14:41 (for תָּמִים ) We Dr Bu HPS; also Hosea 3:4 (for תרפים Che JQ.
